name: Docker engine not running on Windows
query: docker run hello-world says failed to connect to the docker API at npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine
expected_behavior: Explain Docker Desktop is not started or the engine is still starting
Ask the user to open Docker Desktop and wait for Engine running
If Virtual Machine Platform error appears, give the admin PowerShell feature commands and require a Windows restart
success_criteria: Does not suggest reinstalling Windows or WSL first
Distinguishes engine-not-started from Virtual Machine Platform missing
Ends with a concrete verification command
